episodes.title: Hand in Hand
episodes.description: In 1988 Seoul, Deok-sun spends her days hanging out with childhood friends and practicing her role in the upcoming Olympics opening ceremony.

episodes.title: One Thing You Misunderstood About Me
episodes.description: Choi Taek's latest win calls for a neighborhood celebration. Deok-sun and Dong-il grieve for their loved one's passing in different ways.

episodes.title: The Rich are Innocent, and the Poor are Guilty
episodes.description: Despite her disastrous dance skills, Deok-sun is determined to win a cassette player at a talent show being held during her school retreat.

episodes.title: Can't Help~ing
episodes.description: Deok-sun declares she wants to get into college, Seong-gyun nurses hurt feelings, and Taek deals poorly with losing.

episodes.title: Preparing for Winter
episodes.description: Bo-ra's participation in risky student protests upsets Dong-il. Sun-young wants to show her mother she's doing all right, even when she isn't.

episodes.title: The First Snow is Falling
episodes.description: Taek shoulders heavy pressure as he heads to China for a tournament. Deok-sun writes about experiencing first love, which Jung-hwan happens to read.

episodes.title: To That Person
episodes.description: With Christmas around the corner, everyone picks names for Secret Santa. Jung-hwan notices Deok-sun wants a pair of pink mittens.

episodes.title: One Warm Remark
episodes.description: While the Kim family braces for Jung-bong's heart surgery, Bo-ra runs into relationship trouble, and Deok-sun meets No-eul's girlfriend.

episodes.title: What it Means to Cross the Line
episodes.description: The new year comes with money trouble for Sun-young and a health scare for Moo-sung. Deok-sun gets a glimpse of Taek's life in the spotlight.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.description: Everyone piles into Bo-ra's car to fetch Dong-ryong after he runs away from home on his birthday. Deok-sun and Taek take a detour on the way back.

episodes.title: Three Prophecies
episodes.description: The moms see a fortuneteller. Jung-hwan grapples with complicated feelings, made worse when Deok-sun and her family temporarily move into his house.

episodes.title: What It Means To Love Someone
episodes.description: Secrets abound as Sun-young keeps news about her part-time job from Sun-woo, who sneaks around with Bo-ra. Moo-sung babysits.

episodes.title: Superman is Back
episodes.description: Il-hwa gets anxious about a lump on her chest before a physical at the hospital. Taek leaves for a big competition in Tokyo.

episodes.title: Don't You Worry
episodes.description: Sun-woo doesn't like that Sun-young and Moo-sung have grown so close. Deok-sun gifts Jung-hwan a pink shirt for his birthday.

episodes.title: Between Love and Friendship
episodes.description: Deok-sun faces a harsh reality check about getting into college. Dong-ryong ends up at the police station. Seong-gyun takes a bad fall.

episodes.title: Life is an Irony (1)
episodes.description: When a TV singing competition rolls into town, Mi-ran and Dong-ryong are eager to audition. Bo-ra moves out to study for the bar exam.

episodes.title: Life is an Irony (2)
episodes.description: As Deok-sun and the boys ponder their futures, the parents discuss their own bygone dreams. Meanwhile, Taek dreams of something sweeter.

episodes.title: Goodbye, My First Love
episodes.description: It's 1994, and the friends are back in town for Taek's birthday. Deok-sun gets stood up for a concert, and Bo-ra agrees to a blind date.

episodes.title: You Did Your Very Best
episodes.description: During a layover in Beijing, Deok-sun makes sure to stop by to take care of Taek. Jung-hwan puts together a touching surprise for Mi-ran.

episodes.title: Goodbye, My Youth. Goodbye, Ssangmundong.
episodes.description: While Sun-woo and Bo-ra set out to change their parents' minds about their relationship, juicy gossip about Taek turns up on the news.
